changeSet.author: openelis
changeSet.comment: Retire active QC targets that do not fit their test's primary result type.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE clinlims.test_qc_target t SET is_active = false, last_updated = now() WHERE t.is_active = true AND CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM clinlims.test_result_component c WHERE c.test_id = t.test_id AND c.is_primary = true AND c.is_active = 'Y' AND c.result_type IN ('D', 'M', 'C')) THEN t.expected_dict_result_id IS NULL ELSE t.expected_value IS NULL OR t.uncertainty IS NULL END
